versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service SecurityAccess (0x27) with sub- function type "requestSeed" and if the requested access type is not already active, the Dcm module shall request a seed by calling the configured Xxx_GetSeed() function (if the configuration parameter DcmDspSecurityUsePort is set to USE_ASYNCH_FNC , refer to configuration parameter DcmDspSecurityGetSeedFnc ).
